basis: Historical original-source custody verification (M13) and source-recorded completed connected-run examination (M14); external engineering reviewer history retained under controlled custody.

admissionRules.sourceIdentity: Compare actual unmodified original bytes against separately held frozen digest; do not invent chronology.
admissionRules.humanIndependence: Authenticate qualified people, conflicts, keys, separate observations and original signatures; distinct keys alone insufficient.
admissionRules.effectObservation: Instrument actual protected consequences separately from workflow decision labels.
admissionRules.routeClosure: Declare all material routes and preserve unexamined alternatives as gaps.
admissionRules.changedCondition: Hold original candidate constant, change material governing condition and observe effect/non-effect.
admissionRules.replay: Retain actual separately executed replay, not an unverified status string.
admissionRules.release: Approve explicit source and customer rights and separately hash minimal public extract before promotion.

nextGate: Two genuinely distinct qualified examiners submit independently signed raw observation carriers for one frozen authorized historic or BYO workflow, followed by human authentication, negative/changed-condition and release review.
